observations.why: Directive with operational cadence and permanence language ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects others to follow.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Identity-level bedrock stated as constitutive creed — an unrehearsed rollback equated to nonexistence, framed as an absolute with no hedging or qualification.
Restates the settled cadence as an operational specification; a structured field entry recording the decision's terms, not an argument for it.
Assigning ownership is a performed ratification of the decision — the speaker is enacting the settlement by naming who carries it.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that unrehearsed capabilities are constitutively absent — not merely risky, but nonexistent?
